description.label: Description
description.value:
Major Mental Mutation

Your head has become a lodestone for electricity and arcs of lightning flicker around you in an alarming way and leap from your eyes in an alarming way. You can, with a successful Opposed Willpower vs Toughness Test, emit an electric charge that gives a @Condition[Stunned] Condition to a person you touch. If you are in combat you must succeed with a Melee (Brawling) Test to touch them first. With a Challenging (+0) Willpower you can send a crackling lightning bolt from your head or eyes to a target within Willpower Bonus yards. The damage is determined by your Willpower Bonus +SL and the attack inflicts 1 @Condition[Blinded] Condition as well. Metal armour does not protect against the damage. Fumbling a Test to use this mutation causes a @Table[minormis]{Minor Miscast}.
